⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. treatment (n)
/ˈtriːtmənt/
sự điều trị, phác đồ chữa trị y tế
Collocation: medical treatment, receive treatment, effective treatment
"Early medical treatment can save the lives of patients with serious heart conditions."
2. symptom (n)
/ˈsɪmptəm/
triệu chứng, biểu hiện của bệnh
Collocation: mild symptom, show symptoms of, relieve symptoms
"A high fever and a persistent cough are common symptoms of a viral flu."
3. diagnose (v)
/ˈdaɪəɡnəʊz/
chẩn đoán bệnh (n: diagnosis)
Collocation: diagnose a disease, be diagnosed with
"Artificial intelligence helps doctors diagnose rare illnesses much more accurately."
4. vaccine (n)
/ˈvæksiːn/
vắc-xin phòng bệnh (n: vaccination — sự tiêm chủng)
Collocation: develop a vaccine, childhood vaccine
"Widespread vaccination programs have protected millions of children from deadly diseases."
5. epidemic (n)
/ˌepɪˈdemɪk/
dịch bệnh bùng phát trên diện rộng
Collocation: flu epidemic, control an epidemic, obesity epidemic
"Strict public health measures are necessary to stop the spread of a dangerous epidemic."
6. infection (n)
/ɪnˈfekʃn/
sự nhiễm trùng, sự lây nhiễm (adj: infectious — dễ lây lan)
Collocation: bacterial infection, prevent infection, respiratory infection
"Washing hands regularly with soap is the simplest way to prevent hospital infections."
7. chronic (adj)
/ˈkrɒnɪk/
mãn tính, kéo dài dai dẳng (như tiểu đường, huyết áp cao; >< acute: cấp tính)
Collocation: chronic disease, chronic back pain, chronic illness
"A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of developing chronic illnesses such as diabetes."
8. preventative (adj)
/prɪˈventətɪv/
mang tính phòng ngừa trước khi bệnh xảy ra (= preventive)
Collocation: preventative healthcare, preventative medicine, preventative measure
"Governments should allocate more funding to preventative healthcare and public sports facilities."
9. longevity (n)
/lɒnˈdʒevəti/
tuổi thọ cao, sự sống lâu (= life expectancy)
Collocation: increase human longevity, secret to longevity
"In Japan, a balanced diet rich in fish and vegetables contributes to remarkable longevity."
10. pharmaceutical (adj/n)
/ˌfɑːməˈsuːtɪkl/
thuộc về dược phẩm, ngành sản xuất thuốc
Collocation: pharmaceutical company, pharmaceutical industry, pharmaceutical research
"Pharmaceutical companies invest billions of dollars in researching new cancer medicines."
11. hygiene (n)
/ˈhaɪdʒiːn/
vệ sinh cá nhân và an toàn dịch tễ
Collocation: personal hygiene, dental hygiene, poor hygiene
"Clean drinking water and good personal hygiene have dramatically reduced childhood mortality."
12. cure (n/v)
/kjʊə(r)/
(n) phương thuốc chữa khỏi hoàn toàn; (v) chữa lành bệnh
Collocation: find a cure for, prevention is better than cure
"As the famous proverb states, prevention is far better and cheaper than cure."
13. immune (adj)
/ɪˈmjuːn/
miễn dịch, có sức đề kháng (n: immunity)
Collocation: immune system, strengthen the immune system
"Adequate sleep and regular exercise help strengthen the body's natural immune system."
14. therapy (n)
/ˈθerəpi/
liệu pháp điều trị (vật lý trị liệu hoặc tâm lý trị liệu)
Collocation: physical therapy, psychological therapy, undergo therapy
"After his knee surgery, the athlete needed three months of physical therapy to walk again."
15. overcrowded (adj)
/ˌəʊvəˈkraʊdɪd/
quá tải, chật kín người (đặc biệt là bệnh viện công hoặc đô thị)
Collocation: overcrowded hospital, overcrowded ward
"Encouraging regular health check-ups helps reduce pressure on overcrowded city hospitals."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Danh Động Từ (Gerund V-ing) Làm Chủ Ngữ & Sau Giới Từ vs. To-Infinitive

• Cụm Danh động từ (V-ing + Noun) làm Chủ ngữ số ít: Mở đầu câu văn học thuật cực kỳ tự nhiên và nâng điểm GRA lên Band 6.5+.
  Ví dụ: Investing in preventative healthcare is much more cost-effective than building more hospitals.

• V-ing sau mọi Giới từ (by, for, in, without, instead of):
  Ví dụ: Citizens can strengthen their immune system by exercising daily and maintaining good hygiene.

• to + V (nguyên mẫu) sau Tính từ (important, essential, necessary, vital):
  Ví dụ: It is essential for governments to fund childhood vaccine programs.

🔵 Tầng 2: Cấu Trúc Bị Động Khách Quan Trong Y Khoa & Chính Sách (Impersonal Passive)

• Công thức khách quan chuẩn IELTS Task 2: It is widely recognized / argued / believed that + S + V
  Ví dụ: It is widely recognized that early diagnosis can prevent chronic diseases from becoming fatal.

• Cấu trúc reduce the burden on + Noun (Giảm gánh nặng lên...):
  Ví dụ: Preventative medicine helps reduce the financial burden on overcrowded public hospitals.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Patients who receive early medical ________ have a much higher chance of full recovery.
2. If you experience ________ such as shortness of breath or chest pain, you should see a doctor immediately.
3. Modern blood tests allow doctors to ________ diabetes long before serious complications appear.
4. Scientists worked around the clock to develop an effective ________ against the new virus.
5. Poor sanitation in the nineteenth century often led to deadly cholera ________ in large cities.
6. Cleaning wounds carefully with antiseptic liquid prevents bacterial ________.
7. Unlike a common cold that lasts a few days, asthma and arthritis are ________ conditions.
8. Health experts argue that ________ medicine, such as vaccination and nutrition education, saves billions of dollars.
9. Advances in modern medicine and clean water have significantly increased human ________ over the past century.
10. Strict government laws require ________ companies to test new drugs thoroughly before selling them.
11. Teaching young children basic hand ________ at school reduces the spread of seasonal flu.
12. Although researchers have not yet found a complete ________ for all forms of cancer, survival rates have surged.
13. Eating fresh citrus fruits rich in vitamin C helps boost the body's ________ system during winter.
14. Talking to a counselor and undergoing cognitive ________ can help employees recover from severe burnout.
15. During the winter flu season, emergency rooms in public hospitals often become severely ________.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 15] Strict food safety ________ must be enforced to protect consumers from poisoning.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 12] Government ________ on public healthcare rose from 9% to 16% of the national budget.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 11] Doctors and nurses who work excessive ________ are at high risk of exhaustion.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 4] A ________ lifestyle with too much screen time and no exercise leads to obesity.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 14] Rural residents often have less access to medical facilities compared to urban ________.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. ________ in preventative healthcare is far more cost-effective than treating chronic diseases at a late stage.
2. Citizens can strengthen their natural immune system by ________ a balanced diet and sleeping eight hours a night.
3. Promoting regular exercise and health check-ups ________ reduce the burden on overcrowded hospitals.
4. It is essential for governments ________ free childhood vaccines to prevent deadly epidemics.
5. It is widely ________ that prevention is much better than cure in public healthcare.
6. Instead of ________ solely on expensive pharmaceutical drugs, patients should also improve their daily lifestyle.
7. Patients ________ are diagnosed with chronic illnesses at an early stage respond much better to therapy.
8. Public health campaigns educate citizens about personal hygiene, thereby ________ the spread of infections.
9. Between 2010 and 2025, average human longevity in developing nations increased ________ five years.
10. If people ________ less processed sugar, the rate of chronic diabetes would plummet.
Điểm: 0/10

👨 Patient: Good morning! I would like to register as a new patient and book a preventative health check-up.
👩 Clinic Receptionist: Certainly. Could I take your surname first? Is it spelled Atkinson?
👨 Patient: No, it is spelled Fitzgerald. That is F - I - T - Z - G - E - R - A - L - D. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Đánh vần họ): FITZGERALD
👩 Clinic Receptionist: Thank you, Mr. Fitzgerald. Are you experiencing any acute symptoms right now, such as a fever or cough?
👨 Patient: No fever, but I have been suffering from chronic back pain because I sit at a computer all day. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Triệu chứng mãn tính): back pain
👩 Clinic Receptionist: I understand. Our doctor can examine your spine and refer you to our physical therapy clinic. 💡 Đáp án câu 3: physical therapy
👨 Patient: That would be great. Do you also offer the seasonal flu vaccine at this health centre?
👩 Clinic Receptionist: Yes, we do. The flu vaccine is £18 for private patients, or completely free if you have a university health card.
👨 Patient: I am a full-time postgraduate student, so I have my university health card with me. 💡 Bẫy chi phí câu 4: free / 0

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Rising Burden of Chronic Illnesses]
Over the past century, breakthroughs in pharmaceutical research, clean water, and personal hygiene have dramatically increased human longevity. Childhood vaccines and antibiotics have enabled doctors to cure many deadly bacterial infections and prevent global epidemics. Paradoxically, however, public hospitals in many developed nations are more overcrowded than ever before. The primary reason is the rapid rise in chronic lifestyle diseases, such as heart disease, obesity, and type-2 diabetes.

[Paragraph B - The High Cost of Late-Stage Treatment]
When governments allocate almost their entire healthcare budget to hospital treatment and surgery, they are only addressing illnesses after severe symptoms have already appeared. Even when doctors diagnose a chronic condition accurately, long-term drug therapy and intensive care place a massive financial burden on taxpayers. Treating a patient with advanced heart disease costs ten times more than helping that person stay healthy in the first place.

[Paragraph C - Shifting Towards Preventative Healthcare]
Consequently, public health experts argue that investing in preventative healthcare is the most sustainable solution. By funding community sports centres, taxing sugary drinks, and educating citizens on nutrition, governments can strengthen the population's natural immune system. Empowering individuals to take care of their own wellbeing not only improves quality of life but also keeps hospital beds free for urgent emergencies.
Điểm: 0/6

Đề bài: Some people believe that governments should allocate a larger proportion of the national health budget to preventative healthcare and health education rather than hospital treatment. Write a paragraph (75 - 95 words) explaining why you agree or disagree with this view.
